lines.japanese:
旧環太平洋保健機関神戸センターによる病原体実験施設安全対策必携に基づく
緊急勧告は、国家全域に病原体・組換微生物・生物製剤による感染・発病等の可
能性があるとした。
　非常災害による予想されうる被害は、国内経済と公共福祉に重大な影響を及ぼ
す激甚なものであるとし、国家公安委員会の勧告に基づいて内閣　総理大臣は
２０＊＊年＊月＊＊日、緊急事態の布告を発した。
lines.english: The emergency advisory issued by the former Pacific Rim Health Organization's Kobe Center under its Handbook of Safety Measures for Pathogen Research Facilities warned of a nationwide risk of infection and disease from pathogens, recombinant microorganisms, and biological agents. The resulting disaster was projected to inflict catastrophic damage on the national economy and public welfare. Acting on the recommendation of the National Public Safety Commission, the Prime Minister proclaimed a state of emergency on 20**/**/**.

lines.japanese:
また内閣府に緊急災害対策本部が設置されると同時に、所轄区域を国内全域と
定め、災害対策基本法第２８条の３第８項に基づき同内閣府に緊急災害現地対策
本部を設置。
lines.english: At the same time, an Emergency Disaster Response Headquarters was established within the Cabinet Office, with jurisdiction over the entire nation. Pursuant to Article 28-3, Paragraph 8 of the Disaster Countermeasures Basic Act, an On-Site Emergency Disaster Response Headquarters was established there as well.

lines.japanese:
また国立微生物資源研究所による報告から同生物災害は間接侵略の可能性も高
く、総理大臣は通常の警察体制による治安維持確保は不可能であると判断、自衛
隊に治安出動を命じた。
lines.english: A report by the National Institute of Microbial Resources further indicated a strong possibility that the biological disaster constituted indirect aggression. Finding the normal police apparatus incapable of maintaining public order, the Prime Minister ordered a public-security deployment of the Self-Defense Forces.

lines.japanese:
これらの体制は長期に渡って想定され、権力の濫用が懸念されたが、総理大臣
は本件を未曾有の国家災害であると認知しており、緊急事態に対する特別措置の
準用範囲内であるとした。
lines.english: These measures were expected to remain in place for an extended period, raising concerns over abuses of power. The Prime Minister, however, regarded the incident as an unprecedented national disaster and maintained that the measures fell within the applicable scope of special provisions for states of emergency.

lines.japanese:
この一連の災害対策に関し、ライフラインの早急な維持確保に動くとともに、
同種災害に対処している米国と歩調を合わせ、亜細亜ならびに欧州方面への警戒
を強めた。
lines.english: Alongside urgent efforts to keep essential services functioning, the response was coordinated with the United States, which was confronting a disaster of the same kind, while vigilance toward Asia and Europe was heightened.

lines.japanese:
緊急事態宣言は布告から１年が経過した２０＊＊年＊月現在、なおも持続。
　宣言が解除されないこと、また教師などの人員が圧倒的に不足していることな
どから、各教育機関の授業は無期延期となっている。
lines.english: As of */20**, one year after its proclamation, the state of emergency remains in effect. With the declaration still in force and teachers and other personnel in critically short supply, classes at all educational institutions have been suspended indefinitely.
In other words, this is wartime.
